name: Tourist Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Applicants (for nationalities requiring a visa) must provide a hotel reservation showing entry and exit dates, a return plane ticket, and financial documentation (bank statement, credit card, and proof of profession/salary). Documents must be in Arabic, French, or English. Submission does not guarantee approval -- General Security may request further documents at its discretion.
requirements.fix_path: Prepare hotel booking, return ticket, and financial documentation for submission to Lebanese General Security or a Lebanese mission abroad.

evidence_required.document: Bank statement / credit card / proof of profession and salary

outcome.duration_length: not confirmed precisely in this build; described only as non-renewable and not convertible to a work visa without the General Director's authorization

sources.title: General Directorate of General Security (Lebanon's immigration/visa authority) -- tourist visa document requirements: hotel reservation, return ticket, financial proof; visas not renewable and not convertible to work visas without authorization

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Lebanon). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- sourced directly to the Lebanese General Security (GDGS) website, the actual government authority issuing entry visas and residency permits, so this is a genuine tier-1 route. GAP, DISCLOSED NOT INVENTED: GDGS references a separate list of nationalities eligible for visa-free entry or visa-on-arrival, and the specific validity period/fee for the tourist visa, but this build could not retrieve that list's specific content from the page reviewed -- worth a dedicated follow-up rather than guessing a duration or fee. duration_length is intentionally left as a text description rather than a fabricated number of days.
